sites.name: Alta Ghost Town & Mining District
sites.location: Alta Lakes / Alta Basin, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: Alta is a documented historic mining townsite and district in the San Miguel mining region. Official geologic, county, and preservation records support the townsite and associated mining landscape as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Bridal Veil / Smuggler-Union Powerhouse
sites.location: Bridal Veil Basin near Telluride, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: The Bridal Veil / Smuggler-Union Powerhouse is a documented historic hydroelectric mining facility associated with the Smuggler-Union Mining Company. Official historic-register records support the surviving powerhouse as a stable Scan identity.

sites.name: Lewis Mill
sites.location: Bridal Veil Basin, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: Lewis Mill is a documented historic ore-concentration mill in Bridal Veil Basin. Official county and state historic records support the surviving mill complex as a stable Scan identity.

sites.name: Matterhorn / Valley View Mill
sites.location: Matterhorn / Ophir area, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: Matterhorn Mill, also known as the Valley View Leasing & Mining Company Mill, is a documented historic flotation mill south of Ophir. Official historic records support the surviving mill as a stable Scan identity.

sites.name: Ophir Mining Town
overview: Ophir is a documented historic mining town in the San Miguel Mountains. Federal geologic records and Town of Ophir documentation support the surviving community and mining-town identity for Scan.

sites.name: Smuggler-Union Mine Complex
sites.location: Telluride area, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: The Smuggler-Union is a documented major mine complex in the Telluride mining district. Federal, town, and state mining records support the multi-workings complex as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Telluride Historic Mining District
overview: The Telluride Historic Mining District is a nationally recognized historic mining-town district. National Park Service and History Colorado documentation support the town and district core as a stable Scan identity.

sites.name: Tomboy Mine & Ghost Town
sites.location: Tomboy Basin above Telluride, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: Tomboy is a documented historic mine and mining settlement in Tomboy Basin above Telluride. Federal mining records and county documentation support the basin, mine workings, and townsite as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Liberty Bell Mine & Upper Camp
sites.location: Upper Telluride mining district, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: Liberty Bell Mine and its upper camp are documented historic components of the Telluride mining district. Existing research supports the mine-and-camp identity as a basic Scan record.

sites.name: Ophir Loop / Rio Grande Southern Railroad Loop Complex
sites.location: Ophir area, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: The Ophir Loop is a documented Rio Grande Southern railroad alignment and engineering complex near Ophir. Existing research supports the historic loop and surviving railroad landscape as a basic Scan identity.

sites.name: Rio Grande Southern Trout Lake Water Tank
sites.location: Trout Lake, San Miguel County, Colorado
overview: The Trout Lake water tank is a documented surviving Rio Grande Southern railroad service structure. National Register and HAER documentation support the tank as a stable basic Scan identity.
